annotations.title: Paint Coverage Estimate (Gallons for Walls Less Openings)

description: Work out how much paint to buy. Send the walls (width x height, or an area, with a count), the doors and windows to leave out (the same way), the spreading rate from the paint's label (square feet per gallon, or m2 per litre with units metric) and the number of coats, plus an optional waste percent. Get back the gross wall area, the openings, the net area, the area painted (net x coats), the paint needed, and what to buy rounded up: whole gallons, and gallons plus quarts (or whole litres). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/paint-coverage). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional job label (your own text, echoed; not an address or a person).

openings.description: Optional doors, windows and other areas not painted (up to 100): width and height, or area; optional count.

area.description: Area instead of width x height (sq ft or m2).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'door' (your own text, echoed).

width.description: Width (ft, or m with units metric).

spreading_rate.description: Coverage of one coat from the paint's label or data sheet: sq ft per gallon (often 250 to 400), or m2 per litre with units metric.

units.description: us (default): feet, square feet, sq ft per gallon, US gallons. metric: metres, m2, m2 per litre, litres.

walls.description: Surfaces to paint (up to 100): width and height, or area; optional count.

area.description: Area instead of width x height (sq ft or m2).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'north wall' (your own text, echoed).

width.description: Width (ft, or m with units metric).

waste_percent.description: Extra for rough or porous surfaces, spills and touch-up, in percent (default 0).

name: paint_coverage
